title: Short-lived tokens in sessionStorage
statement: Internal tool behind VPN: short-lived (15 min) access tokens may be kept in sessionStorage; no refresh tokens; SSO via the company identity provider.
rationale: The tool is only reachable on the VPN and sessions are short.
quote: Inside the VPN we keep the 15-minute access token in sessionStorage and rely on SSO — no refresh tokens.

title: RFC 7807 errors
quote: All error responses are RFC 7807 problem+json.

title: Money as NUMERIC(12,2)
statement: Money is NUMERIC(12,2) via SQLAlchemy Decimal.
rationale: Finance team reports read decimals directly.
quote: Amounts are NUMERIC(12,2) mapped to Decimal in SQLAlchemy.

title: pytest with factory-boy
statement: Tests use pytest with factory-boy fixtures.
quote: pytest plus factory-boy for fixtures, like our other services.
